must_identify.item: The new ReplicaSet cannot create pods (FailedCreate) because the ResourceQuota compute-resources requests.memory limit is exhausted
must_identify.evidence: ReplicaSet shop/api-67cc856b45(Deployment/api) - Error: pods "api-67cc856b45-hsx6j" is forbidden: exceeded quota: compute-resources, requested: requests.memory=32Mi, used: requests.memory=200Mi, limited: requests.memory=200Mi

must_identify.item: It is a stuck rollout with the old pods still serving, not an outage and not a pod crash

notes: The RCA correctly quotes the quota error on the new ReplicaSet. It never says the old api pods are still serving, and 'Pod cannot start' wrongly implies a pod object exists. Fix option 3 (reduce the request below 32Mi) would not work, since any added request exceeds a fully used quota. The primary fix of raising the quota is valid. No commands were recorded, so the evidence source is unverified.
